name: bounce
description: Mount-time overshoot bounce. Scale 0.7 → (1 + intensity) → 1 with synced opacity fade. Different from <Pulse> (continuous) and <ScaleIn> (no overshoot) — Bounce is for items landing into a layout with personality.

examples.title: Toast bounce
examples.description: Toast notifications bounce in for emphasis.

ai.whenToUse: Use for toasts, achievement unlocks, or any 'celebrated' moment in the UI. Reach for ScaleIn instead when the moment doesn't warrant the overshoot personality.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for high-frequency events (typing feedback, scroll position) — the bounce gets exhausting fast.
commonMistakes: Intensity > 0.3 looks cartoonish; keep ≤ 0.2 for product UI.
Bouncing 4+ items at once with no stagger — they compete; pair with <Stagger>.
ai.accessibilityNotes: Reduced-motion mode collapses to instant final-state.
